(2) How to merge (key on productId, latest sourceVersion wins, events out of order, Discontinued) goes into one shared join helper on the platform. title: Probe: how buyers find the right drone (buyer journey and job stories)
description:
CJ 2026-10-28: drone-web has no ADDR for the buyer side. Research how end users find and choose the right drone, as input for buyer personas and job stories (ADDR Align) before any ordering model.

Sources: buyer guides, retailer category pages and filters, forums and reviews (FPV, hobby, camera drones, professional and agricultural use), e-commerce UX research on guided selling and product finders for complex technical products.

Questions: buyer segments and their jobs (first drone, FPV pilot, upgrade, professional); decision criteria (use, budget, flight time, camera, weight and EU class C0 to C6, legal limits, compatibility with existing gear); where they get stuck and what makes them buy; what a guided 'find the right drone' flow looks like; which steps change state (saved builds, wish lists, quotes, orders) rather than just read.

Output: a report in drone-web design/ (for example design/ordering/research/buyer-journey.md) through a PR, with sources, plus draft job stories in drone-web's JS format. Relates to galaxitech-website-2kv (Ask drone-web).

title: drone-web: build one representative, viewable event model with our event modeling skills
description:
Why: drone-web isn't ready to link from talks or CVs (PR #45 removed the link from the switchON talk). A viewable event model is the first thing that would make it worth showing.

Notation: Kairos. Write the model as a *.kairos.yml file following event-model-factory/dsl/kairos: kairos.schema.json is the spec, with spec-v0.md and rules.md alongside, and examples/library.kairos.yml shows a worked model. Validate it with dsl/kairos/tools/validate.mjs (aim for a clean report with nonzero slice and test counts, and keep the --receipt). Render it with dsl/kairos/tools/render.mjs for the viewable, linkable static view. Kairos is still a v0 draft (bead emf-bzu.1). File any gaps the drone-web model hits as beads in event-model-factory, and don't work around them silently.

What exists: drone-web/design/catalog-management-v2/eventmodel/config.json (Mar 2026), 78 slices in Event Model Studio format, starting with 'Create A New Product Master Record'. It looks generated, with boilerplate GWT ('Given authorization and valid business preconditions…'). Use it as input to review, not as truth.

Do:
1. Choose ONE representative flow with CJ. Suggestion: a customer ordering a drone (storefront to order placed to fulfilment), or product lifecycle in catalog management.
2. Model it in Kairos with our event modeling skills (em-studio-explore: structure, add-tests, critique, narrate). Write concrete GWT specs with real example data, not boilerplate.
3. Make it viewable: render the Kairos model to a static view that galaxi.tech can link to, and, if useful, also in Event Model Studio.
4. Show CJ, then iterate.

Afterwards (separate beads): more flows, then decide whether drone-web can be linked again from the talk and the CVs.

title: drone-web: 'Ask drone-web', customers' questions answered by an agent over the knowledge graph and data products
description:
CJ idea 2026-10-26 (from watching 'The Handoff | Live with Nick Brady' on A2UI): end users can ask drone-web questions in plain language, and an agent answers. Design it as an event-modelled feature and the shared example for the A2UI post and for Kairos's handling of LLM decisions.

Scenario (job story JS4 Compatibility Verification; also JS1 discovery and JS3 comparison): a Professional Integrator asks "Will this 6S battery work with this ESC and flight controller?" or "Which motors fit a 7-inch frame under 400 g?".

How the answer is made (each part is a design question, not a decision yet):
- Knowledge graph: components, specs and compatibility relations (voltage, current, physical fit, protocol) as a graph the agent queries; see the knowledge-graph repo (C:\dev\repos\knowledge-graph) and docs/research/event-model-map.md.
- Data mesh: the graph is fed from drone-web's published streams / data products (Product Lifecycle is the master-data context, D-039/D-040; published vs internal events, D-045/D-046; contracts per D-044). Which data products does the graph consume, and who owns the graph (a consumer-aligned data product?).
- Decision endpoint (LLM): classifies the question into a typed choice (compatibility / comparison / discovery) and extracts the components; modelled as a translation slice that produces a command, not inside a Decider (see the event-model-factory bead on LLM decisions).
- Decider: deterministic actions that follow, e.g. SaveBuild or RequestQuote, tested with GWT specs.
- Identity: actions taken by the agent carry 'agent on behalf of user' (both identities), so the event log tells human from agent actions.
- A2UI: the answer is rendered as declarative UI from drone-web's own storefront components (compatibility checklist card, comparison table, product cards), not as chat text or generated HTML; ties to Tessera's component catalog (event-model-factory emf-1g5.18 / emf-1g5.21).

Output: an event model for the 'Ask drone-web' flow (screens, translation slice, commands, events, views, GWT specs) in drone-web's design folder, plus a short note on which data products feed the graph. No code yet. Related research: galaxitech-crew-doq (A2UI, crew-wide).

Do: add .gitattributes with '*.kairos.yml text eol=lf' (consider *.intent.yml and last-check.json too), run 'git add --renormalize .', confirm both receipts (design/ordering/eventmodel, design/catalog-management-v2/eventmodel) still match. Consider the same rule in event-model-factory.

title: Probe: realistic order rules for selling drones in the EU
description:
CJ 2026-10-28 dropped the made-up rule ORD-003 (1 to 5 drones per order). Research the real rules a drone web shop must enforce, as business rules for the ordering model and its future ADDR run.

Topics: EU drone regulation (class labels C0 to C6, operator registration, minimum age, Remote ID) and what a seller must check or tell the buyer; lithium battery shipping limits (UN3480/UN3481, air vs road); export control and dual-use rules for drones and parts; common fraud and quantity limits in e-commerce for high-value goods; Danish and EU consumer rules (right of withdrawal, payment capture timing).

Output: a rule list with sources, in drone-web design/ordering/research/ through a PR. Research, not legal advice.
notes:
